description: This file defines API route handlers for event management, weather scoring, and recommendations in a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, retrieving, scoring, and generating recommendations for events, with integrations to weather and geocoding services.

methods.name: EventResponse create_event(payload: EventRequest, repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo))
methods.description: Handles creation of a new event by storing it in the in-memory repository.

methods.name: List[EventResponse] list_events(repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo))
methods.description: Returns a list of all stored events.

methods.name: EventResponse get_event( event_id: str = Path(..., description="Event identifier"), repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo), )
methods.description: Retrieves a single event by its unique ID.

methods.name: RecommendationResponse get_recommendations( event_id: str = Path(..., description="Event identifier"), repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo), )
methods.description: Provides placeholder weather-aware recommendations for a specific event.

methods.name: ScoreResponse score_event_date(payload: ScoreRequest)
methods.description: Scores time windows for a specific date and location based on weather forecast.

methods.name: RecommendationResponse post_recommendations(payload: RecommendationRequest)
methods.description: Generates recommendations for an ad-hoc event using live geocoding and weather forecast.

ctags.name: get_event
ctags.signature: ( event_id: str = Path(..., description="Event identifier"), repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo), )

ctags.name: get_recommendations
ctags.signature: ( event_id: str = Path(..., description="Event identifier"), repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo), )
